purpose: single game-ready chase creature for playable/yeti.js
required_parts: large planted foot and a lifted foot
relations: bind pose is a run contact, face along Blender -Y
origin on the ground between the feet
planted sole is the lowest vertex
in-place YetiRun cycle, no root translation

surface_targets: fur reads as clumps in silhouette and albedo
fur value stays below snow white

review_questions: Does the silhouette read as a running snowman rather than a standing or T-pose figure?
Does the fur stay visible on a white or snow ground?
Is the body narrow enough that a 3.4 m catch is still fair?
